phases.title: Add 004_users.sql migration
phases.notes: Create src/benchmark-backend/src/db/migrations/004_users.sql with the users table (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, password TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))). The migrate.ts runner picks up all *.sql files sorted alphabetically, so naming is sufficient — no code changes needed.

phases.title: Create authSchema.ts with Zod schemas
phases.notes: Create src/benchmark-backend/src/schemas/authSchema.ts. Export registerSchema (z.object with email: z.string().email(), username: z.string().min(1), password: z.string().min(8)) and loginSchema (z.object with email and password). Follow the pattern in src/schemas/favouriteSchema.ts.

phases.title: Create authService.ts (register, login, getById)
phases.notes: Created src/benchmark-backend/src/services/authService.ts with register(), login(), getById(). Added bcrypt and jsonwebtoken (plus @types) to package.json and ran pnpm install --offline (packages were already in .pnpm store). Build passes. Auth tests all 404 as expected since routes/controllers are not yet wired up (phases 4-6). Existing product tests still pass (20/20).

phases.title: Create requireJwt.ts middleware
phases.notes: Created src/benchmark-backend/src/middleware/requireJwt.ts. Extracts Bearer token from Authorization header, verifies with jsonwebtoken using JWT_SECRET (falls back to 'default-dev-secret' if env var not set). On success, attaches decoded payload to req.jwtPayload. On missing/invalid/expired token, responds 401 { error: 'Unauthorized' }. Also added jwtPayload?: { userId: string; email: string; username: string } to src/types/express.d.ts. Build passes. Test failures are 404s from routes not yet mounted (phases 5-6 still open).

phases.title: Create authController.ts (register, login, me handlers)
phases.notes: Created src/benchmark-backend/src/controllers/authController.ts with registerHandler (201 { user, token }), loginHandler (200 { user, token }), and meHandler (200 safe user). All read from req.validated (set by validate middleware). meHandler reads userId from req.jwtPayload. Errors propagate via next(err). Build passes.

phases.title: Create authRoutes.ts and mount at /api/auth in app.ts
phases.notes: Created src/benchmark-backend/src/routes/authRoutes.ts with POST /register (validate+registerHandler), POST /login (validate+loginHandler), GET /me (requireJwt+meHandler). Added authRoutes import to app.ts and mounted at /api/auth before the 404 catch-all. All 34 tests pass (including 14 auth tests), build succeeds.

phases.title: Run tests and verify all auth tests pass
phases.notes: All 34 tests pass (2 test files: products and auth), build succeeds (tsc -p tsconfig.build.json). No changes required — previous phases had already wired everything correctly.
